```{r load-lib, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(dbplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(patchwork)
# Add any other libraries here


```

```{r load-data}
# load your data 

df = read.csv("data/SeoulBikeData.csv", fileEncoding = "latin1") %>% clean_names()

```

```{r summary data here}

df %>% group_by(seasons) %>% summarise(mean_bike_count = mean(rented_bike_count, na.rm= TRUE))
df %>% group_by(date = dmy(date)) %>% summarise(mean_bike_count = mean(rented_bike_count, na.rm= TRUE))
df %>% group_by(hour) %>% summarise(mean_bike_count = mean(rented_bike_count, na.rm= TRUE))


df %>% mutate(
  temp_grp = factor(case_when(
    temperature_c <= -10 ~ "Extremely low",
    temperature_c >= -10 & temperature_c < 0 ~ "Very low",
    temperature_c >= 0 & temperature_c < 10 ~ "Low",
    temperature_c >= 10 & temperature_c < 20 ~ "Mid",
    temperature_c >= 20 & temperature_c < 30 ~ "High",
    temperature_c >= 30 & temperature_c < 40 ~ "Very high",
    TRUE ~ "Extremely high" 
  ), level = c("Extremely low", "Very low", "Low", "Mid", "High", "Very high", "Extremely high"))) %>% group_by(temp_grp) %>% summarise(mean_bike_count = mean(rented_bike_count, na.rm= TRUE))


```

```{r trial1}


trialdf1 = df %>% select(-functioning_day, -holiday) %>% group_by(hour, seasons) %>% 
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(rented_bike_count, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

trialdf2 = df %>% select(-functioning_day, -holiday) %>% group_by(hour, seasons) %>% 
  summarise(
    m = mean(temperature_c, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

coeff = 0.01

ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = trialdf1, aes(x = hour, y = Mean), stat = "identity", alpha = 0.7, fill = "lightblue") +
  geom_point(data = trialdf2, aes(x = hour, y = m/coeff), size = 2, colour = "grey") +
  facet_wrap(~ seasons) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Mean Rented Bike Count",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~.*coeff, name="Mean Temperature (C)")
  )+
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "lightblue", size=13),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "grey", size=13)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Hour",
    title = "Effect Temperature has on Rented Bike Count (by hours of the day)"
  ) 


```

```{r trial2}
trialdf3 = df %>% select(-functioning_day, -holiday) %>% group_by(hour, seasons) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_bike_count = mean(rented_bike_count, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

trialdf4 = df %>% select(-functioning_day, -holiday) %>% group_by(hour, seasons) %>% 
  summarise(
    mean_temperature = mean(temperature_c, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
trialdf5 <- inner_join(trialdf3, trialdf4, by = c("seasons", "hour")) 
ggplot(data = trialdf5, 
       mapping = aes(x = mean_bike_count, y = mean_temperature, colour = seasons)) +
geom_point() + 
  facet_wrap(~ seasons) +
labs(title = "Correlation Between Temperature and Bike Demand",
       x = "Mean Number of Bikes Demanded", 
       y = "Mean Temperature (°C)",
     colour= "Seasons")


```

```{r trial3}
#Correlation between Temperature and Bike Demand
trialdf6 <- df %>% 
  select(date, rented_bike_count, temperature_c, seasons) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%d/%m/%Y")) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(day_bike_count = sum(rented_bike_count), 
            mean_day_temp_c = mean(temperature_c))


coeff <- 0.001

ggplot(trialdf6, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = day_bike_count), colour = "tomato", size = 0.6) + 
  geom_smooth(aes(y = day_bike_count), colour = "tomato", size = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_day_temp_c/ coeff), colour = "cornflowerblue", size = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(aes(y = mean_day_temp_c/ coeff), colour = "cornflowerblue", size = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Date",
       title = "Correlation Between Number of Rented Bikes and Temperature") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Number of Rented Bikes",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~.*coeff, name="Temperature (in degrees celsius)")
  )+
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "tomato", size=13),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "cornflowerblue", size=13)
  ) 

trialdf6 %>% summarise(Correlation = cor(day_bike_count, mean_day_temp_c))

```

``` {r trial 4}
#Correlation between Humidity and Bike Demand
trialdf7 <- df %>% 
  select(date, humidity, seasons, rented_bike_count) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%d/%m/%Y")) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(day_bike_count = sum(rented_bike_count), 
            mean_day_humidity = mean(humidity))


coeff <- 0.001

ggplot(trialdf7, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = day_bike_count), colour = "hotpink", size = 0.6) + 
  geom_smooth(aes(y = day_bike_count), colour = "hotpink", size = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_day_humidity/ coeff), colour = "chartreuse4", size = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(aes(y = mean_day_humidity/ coeff), colour = "chartreuse4", size = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Date",
       title = "Correlation Between Number of Rented Bikes and Mean Humidity") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Number of Rented Bikes",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~.*coeff, name="Humidity (%)")
  )+
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "hotpink", size=13),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "chartreuse4", size=13)
  ) 

trialdf7 %>% summarise(Correlation = cor(day_bike_count, mean_day_humidity))

```

```{r trial 5}
#Correlation between Rainfall and Bike Demand
trialdf8 <- df %>% 
  select(date, rainfall_mm, seasons, rented_bike_count) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%d/%m/%Y")) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(day_bike_count = sum(rented_bike_count), 
            mean_day_rainfall = mean(rainfall_mm))


coeff <- 0.001

ggplot(trialdf8, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = day_bike_count), colour = "violetred", size = 0.6) + 
  geom_smooth(aes(y = day_bike_count), colour = "violetred", size = 0.6) +
  geom_point(aes(y = mean_day_rainfall/ coeff), colour = "royalblue4", size = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(aes(y = mean_day_rainfall/ coeff), colour = "royalblue4", size = 0.6) +
  labs(x = "Date",
       title = "Correlation Between Number of Rented Bikes and Mean Rainfall for a Day") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Number of Rented Bikes",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~.*coeff, name="Rainfall (mm)")
  )+
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "violetred", size=13),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "royalblue4", size=13)
  ) 

trialdf8 %>% summarise(Correlation = cor(day_bike_count, mean_day_rainfall))
```

```{r trial 6}
#How Bike Demand varies across hours of the day in differen seasons
trialdf9 <- df %>%
  select(hour, date, rented_bike_count, seasons)%>%
   group_by(hour, seasons)%>%
   summarise(
     mean_bikes_per_hour=mean(rented_bike_count)
   )
   
ggplot(data = trialdf9, 
       mapping = aes(x = hour, y = mean_bikes_per_hour, colour = seasons)) +
geom_smooth(se = FALSE) + 
  facet_wrap(~ seasons) +
labs(title = "Bike Demand across Hours of the Day for each Season",
       x = "Hour of the Day", 
       y = "Mean Bike Demand",
     colour= "Seasons")
```


```{r trial 7}



trialdf10 = df %>% select(-functioning_day, -holiday) %>% group_by(hour, seasons) %>% 
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(rented_bike_count, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

trialdf11 = df %>% select(-functioning_day, -holiday) %>% group_by(hour, seasons) %>% 
  summarise(
    m = mean(temperature_c, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

coeff = 0.01

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = trialdf10, aes(x = hour, y = Mean), stat = "identity", alpha = 0.7, colour = "plum") +
  geom_smooth(data = trialdf10, aes(x = hour, y = Mean), colour = "plum", size = 0.6, se = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = trialdf11, aes(x = hour, y = m/coeff), size = 2, colour = "palevioletred") +
  geom_smooth(data = trialdf11, aes(x = hour, y = m/coeff), colour = "palevioletred", size = 0.6, se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ seasons) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Mean Rented Bike Count",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~.*coeff, name="Mean Temperature (C)")
  )+
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(color = "plum", size=13),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "palevioletred", size=13)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Hour",
    title = "Effect Temperature has on Rented Bike Count (by hours of the day)"
  ) 


cor(trialdf10$Mean, trialdf11$m)


```
